decisions.reason: As a naval vessel lighting system, it is closely related to specialised marine lighting capabilities the firm is likely to already possess, and its continued website presence suggests enough learning and customer traction to justify further development rather than withdrawal.

This general interior lighting luminaire fits the firm's core lighting knowledge, but because it appears more standardised and was less prominently featured in 2024, management would keep it with a higher review risk if follow-on learning and differentiation remain limited.

The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics builds directly on established luminaire and optical design know-how, and its continued 2024 promotion indicates the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it within its existing competence base.

A marine searchlight is strongly aligned with specialised marine and technical lighting knowledge, and because the firm kept it while removing another marine searchlight product, management would likely view it as the better platform to retain and improve.
